plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to lower concentration.
Increase SPY to 30% for broad market exposure.
Add QQQ to 20% for more broad index exposure.
Increase CRWD to 10% to focus on quality tech.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, SPAL) to cut risk.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on broad indices and quality tech, holding a larger cash buffer. Expect lower drawdowns but also slower growth.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to minimal levels.
This balances broad index exposure with reduced tech concentration.
The cash buffer is increased to about 10%.
Focus is on risk-first growth with controlled leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5% monthly growth by reducing leverage and concentration. It aims for risk-first growth, blending broad indices with quality tech while maintaining a moderate cash buffer. Expect moderate growth and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to free up capital for higher-conviction plays.
Increase leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to 6% each.
This concentrates exposure in high-beta, leveraged names.
The cash buffer is reduced to approximately 5%.
Leverage is used aggressively to maximize potential gains.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentrating on high-scoring, leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential upside but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income-generating potential.
Add SPY to 20% for broad index exposure and stability.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to cut risk.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
Focus is on capital preservation and reliable income generation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by prioritizing income ETFs and broad indices. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to near zero, aiming for low drawdowns and reliable income. Note that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall.
